title: aspidium montanum
intro: Aspidium montanum, commonly known as Mountain Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exerting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Fern are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include aspidium polysaccharides, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
